source.text: ועלי זקן מאד וישמע את אשר עושים בניו לבני ישראל׃
source.note: Provisional editorial composite, not a transcription of one manuscript or a recovered autograph. The unpointed text retains the declared base except for the recorded changes; interpretive vocalization outside those changes follows the base.

apparatus.reading: ועלי זקן מאד ושמע את כל אשר יעשון בניו לכל ישראל ואת אשר ישכבון את הנשים הצבאות פתח אהל מועד־־־־׃
apparatus.note: Retained complete contrary source; four terminal maqafs here result from loader serialization of internal segments.
Ninety-year component outside supplies; following eight-year completion wholly supplied. Age addition not selected here; direction of relation to4:15 unresolved.
כל absence depends on supplied junction; participle head supplied, שים survives; לבני survives, last two Israel letters doubtful. Not a fully surviving short junction or fresh transcription.

apparatus.reading: καὶ ἤκουσεν ἃ ἐποίουν οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραήλ
apparatus.note: Short selected ending and recipient expression; not a unique Hebrew retroversion or uniform all-Greek reading. Positive all/long-clause branches retained in source assessment.

apparatus.witness: Positive long Greek branches and Josephus5.339
apparatus.note: Greek forms differ; Josephus is a retelling, not an exact Hebrew quotation. No coercion or gifts inserted into this Hebrew-based rendering.
